_comment: Tier-2 for kratos fsi#: KratosFSIApplication exposes 7 Python convergence-accelerator CLASSES (AitkenConvergenceAccelerator, ConstantRelaxationConvergenceAccelerator, IBQNMVQNConvergenceAccelerator, IBQNMVQNRandomizedSVDConvergenceAccelerator, MVQNFullJacobianConvergenceAccelerator, MVQNRandomizedSVDConvergenceAccelerator, MVQNRecursiveJacobianConvergenceAccelerator) plus partitioned utilities (FSIUtils, SharedPointsMapper, PartitionedFSIUtilities{Array,Double}{2,3}D). These are NOT the CoSim file-stem names (block_ibqnls, iqnils, mvqn, block_mvqn, aitken, anderson, constant_relaxation) — verified disjoint here. The prior catalog had 'ibqn' (bare) which is neither a CoSim file stem nor an FSI class. Also locks the install-gap: KratosFSIApplication was missing from the .venv before this campaign. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 adds a name the FSI build does not provide to REQUIRED_ACCEL_CLASSES, so the required set no longer matches dir(FSIApplication). This proves the emptiness assertion really consults the module surface rather than restating a hard-coded list. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: accel_classes_missing=[]. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/fsi_application_accelerator_classes && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
